annotations.title: Ask real people what they would pay

description: Real people read a product or service description and say what they would pay (EUR) and why; you get median, range and reasons. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

description.description: What is being offered – plain words, no personal data.

period.description: Price per purchase, per month or per year (default one_off).
